CustomField.description: Removes all special characters and a leading "1" (if present) from the PersonMobilePhone field. Used for reliable mobile phone matching without considering formatting.
CustomField.formula: RIGHT( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE(PersonMobilePhone, " ", ""), "-", ""), "(", ""), ")", ""), "+", ""), ".", ""), "/", ""), 10 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Removes all special characters and a leading "1" (if present) from the PersonMobilePhone field
CustomField.label: Person Mobile Phone Formatting Removed
